source: CE v5.30 reference manual, reference/manual/pages/, through the two digests in specs/SPEC-0002/sources/. No photograph was read. Drafted by the Panelwright, committed by the Conductor (ADR-0007).

zones.name: Matrix
zones.note: Sixteen columns (steps 1 to 16) and rows 0 to 9, row 0 at the bottom. In Page view row r is track r.

zones.name: SEL column
zones.note: One button and LED per matrix row. The manual says 'one per row' in effect and never prints the count.

zones.name: Mutators
zones.note: Order and side of the matrix are not stated.

zones.name: MIX block
zones.note: One encoder per matrix row. The manual calls it the MIXER block and the MIX encoder block.

zones.name: EDIT block
zones.note: Order and layout of the knobs are not stated (Q04).

zones.name: Outer circle
zones.note: Keys carry Roman numerals as printed labels. Their positions and the number of number keys are not stated.

zones.name: Inner circle (pitch circle)
zones.note: Twelve note keys, an upper C and a low C, and the three keys MOD, SEL and CAD at the bottom of the circle (p020). Which note each key is, and their order on the ring, are not stated (Q33).

zones.name: CHORD block
zones.note: Bottom right of the front panel (p020). Seven buttons; CHORD1 to CHORD7 are also the overload LEDs (p102).

zones.name: Transport
zones.note: The manual gives the Record key an LED (p067). It gives Play, Stop and Pause none (Q26).

zones.name: MODE block
zones.note: The manual never lists what the MODE block holds (Q23).

zones.name: Other keys
zones.note: Keys the manual places in no named block.

zones.name: MIX TARGET row
zones.note: Below the matrix (p038). Its contents are an open group (Q22).
